**What would you like to do that you can't today?**

**Why the current behaviour gets in the way**

**Notes on scope** — Parley deliberately stays small: two files, zero
dependencies, chat as the only interface. Features that fit that shape land
easily; a file-tree panel, diff viewer or embedded editor probably won't (your
real editor is next door). More than two agents in one room is also out of
scope — but a room can seat any two providers, and adding a provider is a small
adapter plus a registry entry.
